name: Healer (Partial)
description: A spellcaster of curative arts. Heal as a bonus skill, the Healing Touch art, and one more art of their choice, with more arts as they advance. The Healer is a partial class: choose a second partial class from the second-class panel. A Healer may pair with a Vowed, a Partial Warrior, a Partial Expert, or a Partial Mage with a partial tradition.

template_requirements.missing_message: a Healer must pair with another partial class
template_requirements.duplicate_message: a Healer must pair with a different partial class
